prompts.vamp2EnemyPromptA: Use case: stylized-concept. A production animation sprite sheet for a realistic gothic side-scrolling action game. EXACTLY 6 COLUMNS by 5 ROWS, 30 separate full-body characters, equally sized cells, each full body fully contained with 10% transparent margin, same baseline at 88% cell height, no crossing cell boundaries, transparent alpha background, no shadows on ground, no text labels or grid. High resolution 3072x2560 if possible. Original designs inspired by mature dark fantasy RPG realism: natural adult anatomy, small heads 1:7 body height, finely painted realistic skin, scarred aged steel, chainmail, weathered leather, heavy frayed velvet. Cool moonlight key light. No black outlines, no exaggerated round bodies, no cartoons, no pixel art, no toy/plastic. All characters are in SIDE THREE QUARTER VIEW facing RIGHT, action horizontal rightwards. Each ROW is SAME CHARACTER CONSISTENT CLOTHES across six animation poses. Every row columns mean: 1 idle menacing standing; 2 walking right left foot forward right arm forward; 3 walking right right foot forward left arm forward; 4 airborne leap with both feet tucked; 5 attack windup with weapon or claw raised BACK; 6 attack follow-through towards RIGHT with weapon or claws extended. ROW 1 lean aristocratic vampire male, pale gray skin, slick dark hair, fitted black coat and dark wine-red cloak, sharp claws, no weapon. ROW 2 lean WINGED VAMPIRE male, pale muscular but anatomical torso, fitted black trousers, enormous weathered bat wings with visible membranes (wings FIT inside each cell), dark long hair; columns 1,2,3 wings alternate extended/up/down and legs dangle, column4 diving forward, column5 claw windup in flight, column6 claw strike in flight. ROW 3 hulking bald undead brute, enormous but realistic bodybuilder proportions, decayed pale skin, battered black armor and torn burgundy cloth, attacks with fists. ROW 4 ancient necromancer vampire in a dark hood, long layered black robes with oxblood lining and worn leather belts, bone-and-iron staff topped with a small ruby, attack windup and spell cast rightwards. ROW 5 armored executioner vampire with short dark hair, worn blackened plate and chainmail, long-handled iron war hammer, windup and heavy hammer swing rightwards. Genuine detailed alpha-cutout sprites, consistent figure identity within rows, coherent cinematic rendering, crisp clear realistic silhouettes at small scale.
